scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web generate-routes && bun run cf-types && tsc -p packages/contracts && tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p packages/testbed && tsc -p apps/proof && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.deploy:web: bun run --cwd apps/web build && wrangler deploy -c apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: bun run deploy:api && bun run deploy:web
scripts.cf-types: wrangler types -c apps/api/wrangler.local.jsonc apps/api/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime false && wrangler types -c apps/web/wrangler.jsonc apps/web/worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime false
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test && bun run --cwd apps/api db:smoke:local && bun run test:e2e
